meta.title: 22 Things to do in Hoi An and Da Nang - 5D4N Itinerary | Vietnam
meta.description:
Hoi An and Da Nang is one of the top travel destinations in Vietnam. In this video, we spent 5 days and 4 nights exploring the beautiful city, checking out some of the best things to do, and tasting delicious local street food. 

➡️SUBSCRIBE for more videos:-  @PuriandSue 
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Itinerary:

➡️Ba Na Hills Day 3

➡️Da Nang Day 4

comments.author: @danangcity-s1e
comments.text:
Yes, the image in English means ''Born to drift free” Similar to other familiar names the top-of-the-line electric motorcycle is the Vinfast Viper and when associated with Da Nang city and Hoi An ancient town creates a poetic parallel image. It reflects both the free-spiritedness of a young, modern city and the tranquil rhythm of an ancient heritage site.
- Modern Da Nang: A city of bridges, beaches, and a dynamic pace of life, always looking towards the future.
- Ancient Hoi An: An ancient town with lanterns, moss-covered tiled roofs, where memories and culture are preserved.
- The spirit of freedom: On one side, a constantly moving flow; on the other, a stillness that remains open to the world.
This combination makes the phrase “Born to drift free” a powerful and evocative message: both an invitation to tourists and an affirmation of the identity of this Central Vietnamese region I LOVE VIETNAM FORM DA NANG CITY AND HOI AN ANCIENT.

comments.text:
Liked your vid but don't be fooled by Vietnam. If the tourists like something they will pile it on till they ruin the original attraction.

We first travelled to Hoi An in 2002 and there was no coast road, no bridges across the river, gravel streets and no lantern festival. As long as the food is sublime it will be a worthwhile destination, but they are trying hard to ruin the place for foreign currency.

Looking at Phu Quoc for 2024 but it's looking like Disneyland.
